decision.comment: Training stage is clean and internally consistent. No deterministic findings. Key verifications: (1) ResNet18 fixed topology correctly applied — hidden=48 sets base width, depth=3 is inert per fixed-topology rule; generic transformer fields (mlp_ratio, num_heads, patch_size, pooling, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers) are inactive for this CNN family and do not alter topology. (2) Augmentations (hflip, rotate180) are both built-in primitives; no extension-gate approval required. (3) Data integrity confirmed: 28×28×3, 9 classes, splits 89996/10004/7180, zero train-val overlap, test not inspected. (4) Training converged healthily: 15 epochs completed, best val accuracy 0.995102 at epoch 12, cosine LR schedule from 3e-4 to 0, train loss monotonically decreasing (0.735→0.496), no signs of overfitting. Early-stopping patience of 3 was correctly exhausted (best at epoch 12, no improvement through epoch 15). (5) The architecture-research 'revise' action is appropriately resolved: the non-built-in augmentation proposals (rotation ±10°, translation ±2 px) were not implemented in the final config, and the 'avoid max-pooling' hard constraint is overridden by ResNet18's fixed topology. (6) Minor note: best_configuration.validation_accuracy (0.994002) differs from train_result.best_val_accuracy (0.995102), consistent with the selection trial being a shorter evaluation than the full 15-epoch run — not a defect. Recurring non-blocking warnings: llm_model_digest null for qwen3.8; prior-art quotes (ghostnet_vgg_robustness, temp_scaling_calibration) should be verified against full papers before further design decisions; OOD evaluation harness must use arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not pooled-sample AUROC. None of these block the training stage.
issues: Architecture research 'avoid max-pooling' stated as hard constraint conflicts with ResNet18 fixed topology (which includes max-pool); resolved by fixed-topology rule but the research document should be softened to a preference to avoid confusion in future stages.
Prior-art quotes for ghostnet_vgg_robustness and temp_scaling_calibration extend beyond truncated source text; verify against full papers before encoding further design decisions.
llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8; exact LLM weights not pinned in run manifest (auxiliary, non-blocking).
OOD evaluation protocol must use arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not pooled-sample AUROC; confirm downstream evaluation harness implements this correctly.
augmentation_model_quality inference generalises beyond its cited quote scope (unlearning quality vs. overall model quality/robustness); treat as unverified until confirmed against full source.
